        echo "p", func_num_args();
        return "value";
    }
}

    public function __toString(): string {
        echo "o", func_num_args();
        Holder::$value = new Inner;
        ini_set("include_path", "mutated");
        return "include_path\0tail";
    }
}
class Owner {
    public function run($v) {
        echo __CLASS__, "/", static::class, ":", func_num_args(), ":", func_get_arg(0), "|";
        ini_restore(new Option);
        echo ini_set("include_path", "after") === "mutated" ? "K" : "BAD";
        echo "|", Holder::$value, "|", func_num_args(), ":", func_get_arg(0);
    }
}
class Child extends Owner {}
class Creator {}
$f = null;
$maker = function() use (&$f) { $f = [new Child, "run"](...); };
$maker->call(new Creator);
unset($maker);
$copy = clone $f;
unset($f);
$copy(...["v" => "x"]);
